# `<util/imgcache.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Small cache of loaded program images, keyed by path.

Lets a shell spawn the same program again without re-reading it from fsd. An entry is valid while the file's size and modification time match.

```c
#include <util/imgcache.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="imgcache_slots"></a>`IMGCACHE_SLOTS` | `8` | Number of images kept; the least recently used is evicted beyond that. |
| <a id="imgcache_path_max"></a>`IMGCACHE_PATH_MAX` | `128` | Longest path that can be cached, including the NUL. |

## Structures

### `ImgCacheEntry` { #imgcacheentry }

One cached image.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `char` | Path the image was read from. |
| `size` | `uint32_t` | File size when it was cached. |
| `mtime` | `uint32_t` | File modification time when it was cached. |
| `last_used` | `uint32_t` | Value of the cache clock at the last hit; for LRU eviction. |
| `obj` | [`Handle`](../../types.md#handle) | Memory object holding the image, or -1 if the slot is free. |

### `ImgCache` { #imgcache }

The cache. A zero-initialised [ImgCache](#imgcache) is ready to use.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `slots` | [`ImgCacheEntry`](#imgcacheentry) | Cached images. |
| `clock` | `uint32_t` | Counter bumped on every hit or insert. |
| `ready` | `bool` | Set once the slots have been initialised. |

## Functions

### `ImgCacheGet` { #imgcacheget }

```c
Handle ImgCacheGet(ImgCache *c, const char *path, uint32_t size, uint32_t mtime);
```

Looks up the image cached for `path`.

An entry whose size or mtime no longer matches is dropped and counts as a miss.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `c` | inout | The cache. |
| `path` | in | Path of the program. |
| `size` | in | Current file size. |
| `mtime` | in | Current file modification time. |

**Returns:** The image object, still owned by the cache, or -1 on a miss.

### `ImgCachePut` { #imgcacheput }

```c
bool ImgCachePut(ImgCache *c, const char *path, uint32_t size, uint32_t mtime, Handle obj);
```

Caches `obj` under `path` and takes ownership of it.

Replaces any previous entry for `path`; when every slot is taken, closes the least recently used entry.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `c` | inout | The cache. |
| `path` | in | Path of the program. |
| `size` | in | File size. |
| `mtime` | in | File modification time. |
| `obj` | in | Memory object holding the image. |

**Returns:** true if cached; false if `path` is too long, and the caller still owns `obj`.

### `ImgCacheDrop` { #imgcachedrop }

```c
void ImgCacheDrop(ImgCache *c, const char *path);
```

Closes and forgets the entry for `path`, if any.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `c` | inout | The cache. |
| `path` | in | Path of the program. |
